content:
At least 20 children have come down with chickenpox in recent days at the Estado de Tamaulipas elementary school at Kilometer 18, south of Nuevo Laredo, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

Cases were first detected in late October and have continued to spread, including from sibling to sibling within households, leaving whole families affected, the newspaper reported. Absenteeism at the school has risen as cases climb.

Parents and teachers reported the situation and, on October 30, delivered a written request to the Distrito de Salud para el Bienestar asking for intervention, according to El Mañana. As of the newspaper's report, there had been no response and no medical visit to the school or to the affected homes, and no statement or specific recommendation from health authorities was quoted in the article.

Classes have not been suspended, according to the report. Families in the area face difficulty reaching nearby medical services, and the article pointed to crowded, small homes and shortages of basic hygiene supplies and medicines for fever and skin relief, as well as needs around isolation, temperature monitoring and disinfection.

Sources: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

title: Chickenpox Outbreak Hits Elementary School at Kilometer 18 in Nuevo Laredo
